messages:
Maya Chen: quick note—I'm carving out a small docs PR to harmonize Optimize recommendations: batching heuristics, cache defaults, and three starter quant profiles. Draft is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501
Diego Morales: nice. can we include one concrete numeric example for each workload? PMs like copy-paste numbers.
Maya Chen: yes — short chat (<=64 tokens), session chat (<=512), long generation (>=1500). will add p95 latency, tokens/sec, and sample $/1k.
Samir Patel: add an SDK snippet showing client-side batching + KV prefetch (python). people keep asking for that exact snippet.
Maya Chen: adding minimal python: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
responses = c.generate_batch(model="rwd-llama-q4", inputs=batch, batch_size=16, prefetch_kv=True)
```
Nina Park: include a short "when NOT to prefetch" note — high-cardinality user prompts, or when prefixes are single-use.
Maya Chen: added that caveat with an example.
Samir Patel: CI pinged a broken link to /console/v1 in heuristics.md. docs-bot, paste job?
docs-bot: CI: docs-check #350 failed — https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/350 — markdown-link-check error at docs/optimize/heuristics.md: line 38 (/console/v1/optimize).
Maya Chen: will swap to /console/v2 and add redirect note. Diego, can you grep images for embedded links?
Diego Morales: yes, I'll scan SVGs and update any v1 references.
Maya Chen: for quant profiles I'm using names: latency-sensitive, balanced, cost-min with keys (dtype, group, fallback). Mapping table included.
Nina Park: add a tiny migration checklist from q8 -> q4_1 and a suggested A/B recipe: 10% traffic for 48h + automated eval + 50 spot checks.
Maya Chen: done. Also putting a short YAML route example for Dedicated customers showing per-route cache TTL and max_kv_entries.
Samir Patel: after merge, let's move the snippets into examples repo so they get linted by CI.
Maya Chen: will open follow-up issue to extract snippets and add tests. Target: bump from DRAFT -> ready by EOD tomorrow. reviewers?
Samir Patel: I'll review perf numbers and quant wording.
Diego Morales: I'll handle link fixes and assets.
Nina Park: I'll review SDK snippets and the migration checklist.
Maya Chen: thanks all ":thumbsup:"
